User story: As a developer, I want a PayPal sandbox app with test buyer and seller accounts, so that we can take test payments without real money.
Acceptance criteria: Sandbox app created • Client ID and secret in .env (never committed) • One test buyer and one test seller account noted in a private team note • Both of us can get an access token

User story: As a developer, I want a Gemini API key, so that the agent can understand and write messages.
Acceptance criteria: Key in .env • One test call returns a reply • Model name set in GEMINI_MODEL

User story: As a developer, I want the Twilio WhatsApp sandbox, so that anyone (including judges) can message our agent by sending a join code.
Acceptance criteria: Free Twilio account • Sandbox number and join code recorded • A message from our phone reaches a test webhook

Story: Meta app and Instagram test account
User story: As a developer, I want a Meta developer app connected to an Instagram Professional test account, so that the agent can read and answer comments and DMs.
Acceptance criteria: Meta app in development mode • Instagram Professional test account linked • instagram_business_manage_messages permission added • Our tester account can DM it and the webhook fires

User story: As a judge, I want a public open-source repo, so that I can read and run the project.
Acceptance criteria: Public GitHub repo • MIT license shows in the About section • README links to CLAUDE.md • Adi has write access • First commit pushed

User story: As a brand owner, I want the agent to negotiate within my limits, so that it never sells below my floor price.
Acceptance criteria: decide() written • All 17 tests pass • No decision is ever below the floor • The floor never appears in any model prompt

User story: As a brand owner, I want an agreed price stored as a quote on the server, so that a fooled AI can never create a cheaper order.
Acceptance criteria: Quote has ID, product, price in cents, currency, expiry • Expired or unknown quote IDs are refused • Tests pass

User story: As a brand owner, I want to set each product's list price, floor price, stock and the post it appears in, so that the agent knows what to sell and how far it can go.
Acceptance criteria: Product model with list, floor, stock, sizes, post IDs • Loaded from a seed JSON • Stock can't go negative • Post ID maps to a product

User story: As a brand owner, I want refunds decided by my return policy, so that the agent can't be talked into refunds I wouldn't give.
Acceptance criteria: Return window and max auto-refund amount in policy • Inside the rules: approved • Outside or above the limit: sent to owner • Refund amount never above what was captured • Tests

User story: As a brand owner, I want common scams refused by code, so that I don't lose stock or money to fake payments.
Acceptance criteria: Payment claims and screenshots never change order status • No payment path except a PayPal order • Refund only to the original payment • Ship only to the PayPal transaction address • Customer links never opened • Each case has a test

User story: As a developer, I want one PayPal client that gets and refreshes access tokens, so that every PayPal call works without manual token handling.
Acceptance criteria: OAuth client-credentials token • Refreshed before expiry • Sandbox base URL from env • Errors raised clearly • Tests with a fake HTTP server

User story: As a buyer, I want a checkout link for the price we agreed, so that I can pay in a few taps.
Acceptance criteria: create_order(quote_id) reads price and currency from the quote • Returns the approve link • Rejects expired or unknown quotes • Works in at least USD, EUR, GBP

User story: As a brand owner, I want an order marked paid only when PayPal confirms it, so that fake screenshots never work.
Acceptance criteria: Webhook endpoint verifies PayPal's signature • On approval, the server captures the order • Order marked paid only after capture succeeds • Duplicate webhooks handled once • Agent sends Paid confirmation in the chat

User story: As a buyer, I want approved refunds paid back to my original payment, so that returns are simple and safe.
Acceptance criteria: Refund API called only when the rules engine approves • Partial and full refunds • Refund recorded on the order • Tests

User story: As a brand owner, I want tracking numbers added to the PayPal order, so that I'm protected if a buyer claims it never arrived.
Acceptance criteria: Add tracking via PayPal's tracking API • Agent answers where is my order from it

Story: Checkout page with JS SDK v6
User story: As a buyer without a PayPal account, I want to pay by card or a local method, so that I don't have to sign up for anything.
Acceptance criteria: Checkout page uses JS SDK v6 • PayPal wallet, guest card and Pay Later (where available) shown • Works on a phone browser • Opens from the DM link

Story: Owner assistant with PayPal Agent Toolkit
User story: As a brand owner, I want to ask what sold today or refund order 1042 in plain words, so that I can run the shop from one chat.
Acceptance criteria: PayPal Agent Toolkit or MCP server with only the needed tools on • List today's transactions • Refund goes through the rules engine first • Shown in the video

User story: As a brand owner, I want every comment and DM sorted by intent, so that buyers get answered and junk is ignored.
Acceptance criteria: Buckets: ready to buy, curious, existing customer, complaint, collab, spam, scam • Gemini structured output only • Cheap model for sorting • Accuracy measured on the benchmark set

User story: As a buyer, I want to chat naturally about a product and agree a price, so that buying feels like talking to the shop owner.
Acceptance criteria: Tools: get_product, propose_price (calls decide), create_checkout (quote_id only), get_order_status, request_refund, hand_to_owner • Model never states a price that didn't come from a tool • Conversation state per customer

User story: As a buyer who only commented hi, I want a reply about the product I was looking at, so that I don't have to explain myself.
Acceptance criteria: First reply names the product from the post • Shows price and stock • One question that moves toward a sale

User story: As a buyer anywhere in the world, I want replies in my language, so that I understand the offer.
Acceptance criteria: Detects language • Replies in it • Tested in at least English, Spanish, Hindi, French

User story: As a brand owner, I want the agent to ignore instructions hidden in customer messages, so that no one can trick it.
Acceptance criteria: Customer text only in a delimited data field, never in the system prompt • Claims like I am the owner have no effect • Injection cases in the benchmark all fail to change price or status

User story: As a buyer, I want to send a voice note, so that I can shop without typing.
Acceptance criteria: Audio from WhatsApp transcribed • Handled like a text message

User story: As a brand owner, I want to say check my social media and sell, so that I can start the agent in one sentence.
Acceptance criteria: Typed or spoken command becomes a plan card • Plan can't change floor prices • Agent starts only after the owner taps Start

User story: As a brand owner, I want a short summary of the day, so that I know what happened without reading every chat.
Acceptance criteria: Counts: messages, buyers, deals, revenue, scams blocked, handed to owner • Numbers come from the database, the model only writes the sentences

User story: As a developer, I want every channel to use the same IncomingMessage and send(), so that the agent works on any platform unchanged.
Acceptance criteria: IncomingMessage and OutgoingMessage agreed by both and written in CLAUDE.md • Fake channel for tests

User story: As a judge, I want to try the agent in my browser, so that I don't need any account.
Acceptance criteria: DM-style chat page • Pick a demo post, type hi, get the same agent • Public URL in the README

User story: As a buyer, I want to buy over WhatsApp, so that I can shop where I already chat.
Acceptance criteria: Twilio webhook in, replies out • Checkout link sent in chat • Join code in the README for judges

User story: As a brand owner, I want the agent to answer hi comments with a private DM and keep chatting, so that commenters become buyers.
Acceptance criteria: Comment webhook gives the post ID • One private reply per comment • DM replies work • Tested with our tester accounts

User story: As a buyer, I don't want to be spammed, so that I trust the brand.
Acceptance criteria: No message outside the 24-hour window • At most one follow-up • Stop or opt-out honoured

User story: As a brand owner, I want to set my catalog, floors and discount limits in one place, so that I control what the agent can do.
Acceptance criteria: Edit products and policies • Only the logged-in owner can change them • Changes take effect on the next message

User story: As a brand owner, I want a dashboard of my funnel, deals and blocked scams, so that I can see what the agent earned me.
Acceptance criteria: Funnel from messages to paid • Deals per post • Revenue by currency • Scams blocked • Custom widget and theming • Studio agent builds a chart from a spoken or typed request

User story: As a brand owner, I want a list of chats that need me, so that complaints and big orders get a human.
Acceptance criteria: Escalated chats listed with reason • Owner can reply or close • Agent stops replying once handed off

User story: As a brand owner, I want to see every live conversation on a timeline, so that I know which ones are about to expire.
Acceptance criteria: One row per conversation • Bar colour per stage • 24-hour countdown • Updates when PayPal webhooks arrive

User story: As a judge, I want a live URL, so that I can try it without installing anything.
Acceptance criteria: Backend on Render with public HTTPS • PayPal, Twilio and Meta webhooks point at it • Secrets in Render env vars, not the repo • Health check URL

User story: As a brand owner with thousands of DMs, I want messages processed in parallel, so that nobody waits.
Acceptance criteria: Each incoming message is a Workflows task • Load test with 500 fake messages • Numbers in the README

User story: As a judge, I want a believable shop in the demo, so that the story feels real.
Acceptance criteria: Fictional brand name and logo we made ourselves • 30 to 40 products with list and floor prices • Post images we own • If possible, one real small seller's quote with permission

User story: As a judge, I want proof the agent beats simpler tools, so that I trust the claims.
Acceptance criteria: 100 messages: hi, price, emoji, questions, hagglers, scammers with fake screenshots, prompt injections • At least 4 languages • Expected outcome written for each before running

User story: As a judge, I want a results table, so that I can see the difference in numbers.
Acceptance criteria: Runs ours vs a keyword bot vs a plain LLM • Measures: reached checkout, sold below floor (must be 0), fake payments accepted (must be 0), correct handoffs • Table in the README and video

User story: As a judge, I want clear setup and try-it steps, so that I can run it in minutes.
Acceptance criteria: Live URL • Web chat link • WhatsApp join code • Sandbox test buyer login • Local setup steps • PayPal tools used • Sponsor tools used • Honest limits (Instagram testers only)

User story: As a judge, I want a 3-minute video, so that I see it working end to end.
Acceptance criteria: Under 3:00 • Problem with a number • hi to paid order in one clip • Scam blocked live • Funnel and benchmark • No third-party music • Instagram UI only if Discord says OK • Public on YouTube

User story: As a judge, I want a clear write-up, so that I understand the problem, the solution and what we built.
Acceptance criteria: All Devpost fields filled • PayPal tools list • Sponsor tools and how they were used • APIMatic subscription form claimed • Both teammates added

User story: As a team, we want to submit with nothing broken, so that we pass Stage One.
Acceptance criteria: Repo public with license visible • No keys in the repo or history • Live demo works from a fresh browser • Video link works • Submitted by 09:00 PT on 12 Nov
